name: PlatformDirector
description: Fail-closed platform decision contract scaffold. The component now defines evidence-bearing architecture, governance, release, exception, risk, priority and emergency decision request/record types, but does not yet implement the full Platform Director runtime required by ADR-0006.
note: 2026-08-02 revalidation: commit cd5c93137074dc7f8a8ba562aff09ea7f54f6a70 introduced Contracts/PlatformDecision.ts. The previous status 'unspecified' and note claiming zero code became stale and broke platformManifestIntegrity. Status is therefore 'development'. This does not close ADR-0006: only the decision contract exists; executable decision orchestration, evidence collection, runtime policy enforcement, event integration and acceptance tests remain outstanding.
